edges.reason: msg.sender is read by _msgSender and drives all ownership/access decisions.
Constructor uses _msgSender to establish the initial owner.
Constructor calls _transferOwnership to write _owner.
transferFrom derives spender from _msgSender().
transfer derives owner from _msgSender().
transferFrom spends allowance via _spendAllowance before transferring.
transferFrom performs tax-collection and final _transfer calls.
transfer performs tax-collection and final _transfer calls.
distributeTaxes moves tokens with repeated _transfer calls.
burn delegates to internal _burn.
Constructor mints the entire supply via _mint.
transferFrom executes amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision tax math.
transfer executes amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision tax math.
Constructor performs the privileged supply mint.
burn lets any caller destroy their own tokens.
addTaxRecipient accumulates _taxTotal = _taxTotal + _tax.
updateTaxPercentage adds/subtracts diff on uint16 _taxTotal.
distributeTaxes transfers contract balance to recipients in a loop.
_taxPercision is the divisor of the tax computation in transferFrom.
_taxTotal is the multiplier of the tax computation in transferFrom.
_taxTotal is read and written in addTaxRecipient.
_taxRecipientAmounts is read and written during tax update math.
_taxActive gates the tax branch in transferFrom.
_whitelisted lookup exempts addresses from tax in transferFrom.
_taxRecipients array is iterated during distribution.
_taxRecipients is mutated via swap-and-pop in removeTaxRecipient.
_taxRecipientAmounts weights each distribution share.
_taxTotal is used as divisor for per-recipient share math.
_owner state variable is written by _transferOwnership.
from parameter feeds allowance spending and transfer in transferFrom.
to parameter is the transfer recipient in transferFrom.
amount parameter drives balance and tax math in transferFrom.
to parameter is the transfer recipient in transfer.
amount parameter drives balance and tax math in transfer.
value parameter is passed to _burn.
wallet parameter is registered as tax recipient.
_tax uint16 parameter is added to _taxTotal.
wallet parameter selects the recipient to update.
newTax parameter drives uint16 tax total arithmetic.
wallet parameter identifies the recipient to remove.
wallet parameter is added to the whitelist mapping.
wallet parameter is removed from the whitelist mapping.

tax local holds the computed tax inside transfer.

currentTax local reads the recipient tax weight.
